name: labelled_candidates
title: Three named directions, not three paragraphs
summary: Six candidates are generated under named instructions -- raise the stakes, slow down, subvert the expectation -- and three are selected for quality and mutual difference. The label is the mechanism: three named directions cost a decision; three unlabelled paragraphs cost three readings. Each candidate arrives already checked, with its flags attached.

steps.title: Six sampled, three shown
steps.note: Every candidate carries its axis label, its rationale, and its flags.

delta_summary: Kael experiences sensory overload
Kael touches the gate
The gate shows signs of sentience
adds beat “The silence of the gate”
introduces character The gate
establishes: Kael wants reconnect with Mara.
establishes: The gate is sentient.
Kael learns this at The silence of the gate
shown.rationale: By focusing on the physical interaction with the gate, we establish the supernatural stakes of the world before moving the plot forward to the Warden's intervention.
shown.text: The silence of the gate Kael stands before the iron, the clang of the gate still vibrating in his teeth. The market stalls are suddenly deserted, the air thick with the smell of ozone and wet ash. He presses his hands against the cold iron, whispering a desperate apology to his sister, Mara. He isn't sure if he's praying or pleading, but the metal shifts—not because he moves it, but because a hum, deep and rhythmic like a heartbeat, pulses from the other side, answering his touch. Kael is desperate and guilt-ridden; the gate is not just iron, but something responsive.

delta_summary: Kael trapped
Warden introduces magical obstacle
adds beat “The Warden's blockade”
introduces place Kell market
introduces character North Gate
establishes: Kael is at Kell market.
establishes: Warden of Kell has iron-bound cage.
establishes: North Gate: magically warded against Kael
Kael learns this at The Warden's blockade
Warden of Kell learns this at The Warden's blockade
shown.rationale: By reinforcing the gate with a magical ward and introducing the Warden, I ensure Kael cannot simply walk away, forcing a direct confrontation that aligns with the established constraint of a closed gate.
shown.text: The Warden's blockade As Kael tries to slip through a secondary gate, the Warden of Kell blocks the path, dragging a heavy, iron-bound cage that seals the exit. The gate is not just closed; it is magically warded against Kael's touch, rendering his attempt to bypass it physically impossible. The Warden has specifically anticipated Kael's movements, and the gate is magically reinforced.

delta_summary: The environment reacts to Kael
The Warden is temporarily incapacitated
The gate's nature is revealed as anomalous
adds beat “A Silence in the Static”
introduces character The gate
establishes: The gate is sensory dampener.
establishes: Warden of Kell: incapacitated by the gate
Kael learns this at A Silence in the Static
shown.rationale: Rather than escalating into a standard combat beat, this creates a psychological imbalance. It forces Kael to navigate a situation where the rules of physics seem to be failing, heightening the mystery of Ashfall.
shown.text: A Silence in the Static Instead of an imposing voice or a magical blast, the heavy iron of the gate itself hums a low, dissonant frequency that vibrates through Kael’s teeth. The Warden of Kell stops mid-stride, his armor rattling in sync with the metal. For a heartbeat, the chaos of the market vanishes—everyone freezes, not out of fear, but because they have momentarily lost the ability to perceive sound or movement. Kael realizes the gate isn't an obstacle; it's a sensory dampener. The gate possesses an active, anomalous property that affects the Warden.

delta_summary: adds beat “Mara's observation”
introduces character pulsating amulet
establishes: Kael has pulsating amulet.
establishes: pulsating amulet is magical.
Mara learns this at Mara's observation
shown.rationale: Shifting the POV to Mara reveals that Kael's predicament isn't just about being trapped, but about a catalyst he is hiding, raising the stakes of his survival.
shown.text: Mara's observation Mara watches from the shadows of a merchant stall as the gate locks Kael in. She sees Kael's desperate eyes scan the empty market and notices him clutching a strange, pulsating amulet he keeps hidden under his cloak. As he cries out into the silence, the amulet glows with a sickly rhythmic light that seems to vibrate the very iron of the locked gate. Kael possesses a magical artifact that reacts to his distress.

delta_summary: adds beat “A voice in the static”
introduces character The gate
establishes: Kael wants find Mara.
establishes: The gate: possesses a sentient or trapped presence
Kael learns this at A voice in the static
shown.rationale: By showing Kael's desperate scan for Mara, we establish his internal priority while externalizing his powerlessness against the Warden. The voice adds a layer of mystery that forces Kael to confront his past.
shown.text: A voice in the static Kael backs into the heavy iron gate, his hand scraping against the cold, rusted metal. He tells the Warden he just wants to leave, but his eyes keep scanning the crowd for Mara. He finds no trace of her. As he exhales, a low, grinding vibration ripples through the gate and into his spine, followed by a voice that isn't his own, whispering a name he hasn't heard in years: 'Kael, be still.' Kael is searching for someone named Mara; an unknown entity or mechanism within the gate is communicating with Kael.

steps.title: The writer takes 'slow down'
steps.note: Accepting commits the diff, extracts facts from any new prose, and shows the bible diff. The alternatives are recorded too -- that is what makes this a preference rather than an event.
